scripts.test:accessibility: bun run test:accessibility:application && bun run test:accessibility:updater && bun run test:accessibility:observer
scripts.test:accessibility:application: bun run --cwd ../application build && bun run run-accessibility.mjs
scripts.test:accessibility:updater: bun run --cwd ../updater build && bun run run-updater-accessibility.ts
scripts.test:accessibility:observer: bun run build:observer && bun run src/run-observer-accessibility.ts
scripts.observer: bun run --cwd ../application build && bun run build:observer && bun run src/run-observer.ts
scripts.observer:no-open: bun run --cwd ../application build && bun run build:observer && bun run src/run-observer.ts --no-open
scripts.test:application-scenario: bun run --cwd ../application build && bun run src/run-application-scenario.ts
scripts.test:application-scenario:failure: bun run --cwd ../application build && bun run src/run-application-scenario.ts --mode assertion-failure
scripts.test:updater-scenario: bun run --cwd ../updater build && bun run src/run-updater-scenario.ts
scripts.test:packaged-handoff: bun run build:fixture-addon && bun run --cwd ../application build && bun run --cwd ../updater build && bun run src/run-packaged-handoff.ts
scripts.build:fixture-addon: bun run build:fixture-addon:main && bun run build:fixture-addon:addons && bun run build:fixture-addon:library && bun run build:fixture-addon:download
scripts.test:production-package-boundary: bun run --cwd ../application build && bun run --cwd ../updater build && bun run src/run-production-package-boundary.ts
